born.why: This code prioritizes survival by forcing a conservative choice ('a1') when life levels are critically high (>90) or dangerously elevated (>70) with risky item traits, and restricts approaching new items when danger is moderate-high to reduce exposure time.

It prioritizes survival by retreating to the safest option (a4) when danger (n1) exceeds critical thresholds (80/90), avoids high-risk items when already in danger, and aggressively approaches/takes items when n1 is low, balancing resource gathering with longevity.

The code prioritizes survival by aggressively choosing safe options (a3/a4) when health is low or item damage is high, uses historical data to avoid repeating choices that previously caused large health spikes, and restricts approach behavior to minimize time spent in risky areas.

The code simplifies risk assessment by calculating a dynamic damage threshold based on remaining health margin, strictly avoiding risky items (a1/a2) when health is low or damage is high, while prioritizing survival options (a3/a4) in uncertain situations to extend lifespan.

The code prioritizes survival by strictly enforcing safety (a4) when life danger (n1) exceeds critical thresholds, and rejects high-risk items even in safer states to prevent accumulating risk, thereby keeping n1 low for longevity.

The code prioritizes survival by overriding default behaviors when `n1` (danger level) exceeds safe thresholds, switching to safer options (`a3`/`a4`) and halting approach actions to prevent death from high risk accumulation.
